description: Testbench inventory for spec rows 1-11 (the per-row table with owner issues is sim/testbench-inventory.md). cold_start is scripts/run-benches.sh: it runs every unattended simulation bench once (nominal corner, one local ngspice at a time, records to a scratch dir) and fails if any cannot run to completion. NOT in cold_start: scripts/run-vco-smoke.sh (needs openvaf-r and the network; its only committed record is a failure, sim/vco-smoke/records/20261018-024845-17e49a8.md), so its files are inventoried as present but it is not attested to run. Corner grids and Monte Carlo are #39/#40 through klt sim. Negative controls shipped: cp-dc, prescaler-g1, loop-tran, jitter (and the fetch/pin tests); pfd-sweep, prescaler-g3 and divider-elab have none yet (sim/testbench-inventory.md).
